title: McKenna brothers' weeks-long mushroom trips in the Amazon

tellings.quote: had multi-weekl long mushroom trips in the Amazon where they would sort of download and channel things.

plain: In the 1970s, the brothers Terence McKenna and Dennis McKenna, both famous for writing about psychedelic drugs, took mushroom trips in the Amazon that lasted for weeks. Michels says that during these trips they would "download and channel things," meaning they felt they were receiving ideas from beyond themselves. He tells it himself, without naming a source.
